request.spec_md:
Task Q1 of the Kognai coding agent qualifier. Conventions: TypeScript (ES modules, Node 20), tests with node:test run by tsx, all files under qualifier/Q1/, tests in qualifier/Q1/*.test.ts named after the task (Q1).

qualifier/Q1/plain-amount.ts exports plainAmount(value, decimals, symbol) -> string. value is an integer number of base units as a string, which may start with a minus sign and may use Arabic Indic digits. The result uses Latin digits, groups thousands with commas, keeps at least 2 and at most decimals decimals (zeros beyond 2 removed from the end), writes a negative value as "minus 1,234.50 USDC" and never contains a dash. Invalid input throws.
